- Model tends to overestimate prices in early forecast windows, especially after sharp spikes; reduce initial forecast peaks by 5–10%.
- Underestimates mean-reversion periods; if sentiment remains flat (0.00) for 10+ days, adjust forecast downward by 2–5% per week.
- Overshoots after high sentiment events (even if sentiment=0.00), especially in 30-day horizon; apply dampening factor of 0.85 to forecasted peaks.
- When true outcome shows strong upward trend (e.g., >+5% from prior 7-day avg), model often lags; shift forecast 1–2 days ahead with slight upward bias.
- If sentiment history is uniformly zero, assume low market volatility; cap forecast range within ±3% of recent 7-day moving average.
- Avoid extrapolating from recent 30-day trend if true outcome deviates >15% from forecast; reset to 14-day rolling average for next 7 days.
